AboutPage.title: About Me
AboutPage.subtitle: Bringing joy and creativity to children's faces
AboutPage.introduction: Welcome to Face Art Obwalden! I bring passion to the art of face painting and create magical moments for children.

story.title: My Story
story.content: What started as a hobby has become a passion for bringing smiles to children's faces. I find it wonderful when I can transform children into their desired design and they beam from ear to ear.

experience.title: Experience & Expertise
experience.content: I'm based in beautiful Obwalden and specialize in creating safe, fun, and unforgettable face painting experiences for children. I only use high-quality, non-toxic, and hypoallergenic paints that are safe for sensitive skin. My designs range from simple and quick for large groups to elaborate masterpieces for special occasions.

commitment.title: My Commitment
commitment.content: I am committed to providing every child with a safe, hygienic, and pleasant experience, ensuring that each design is created with care and attention to detail.

FaqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FaqPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about my face painting services

questions.question: What kind of paints do you use?
questions.answer: I exclusively use high-quality, non-toxic, water-based face paints that are specifically developed for use on skin. All paints are hypoallergenic and safe for children with sensitive skin. They wash off easily with soap and water.

questions.question: How long does each face painting take?
questions.answer: Simple designs usually take 3-5 minutes, while more elaborate designs can take 8-15 minutes. For parties, I recommend planning about 7-10 minutes per child to ensure everyone gets a beautiful design.

questions.question: What age groups do you paint for?
questions.answer: I paint faces for children of all ages, typically from 3 years old. For very young children (under 3), I recommend simple designs on hands or arms.

questions.question: How far in advance should I book?
questions.answer: I recommend booking at least 2-3 weeks in advance, especially for weekend events and during peak season like summer and holidays. However, I do my best to accommodate last-minute requests when possible.

questions.question: What do you need from me as the host?
questions.answer: I only need a space for my table and chair, which I bring. I bring all my materials, including paints, brushes, mirrors, and wet wipes. A shaded area is preferred for outdoor events.

questions.question: Do you have insurance?
questions.answer: Yes, I have comprehensive liability insurance for all my face painting activities. Safety and professionalism are my top priorities.

questions.question: What happens if it rains at an outdoor event?
questions.answer: For outdoor events, I need a covered area to set up in case of rain. If the event is canceled due to weather, we can arrange a new date without additional costs.

questions.question: Can you create custom designs or themes?
questions.answer: Absolutely! I love creating custom designs that match your party theme or your child's favorite characters. Just let me know what you have in mind when you book, and I'll prepare accordingly.

questions.question: How do I care for the face painting after the event?
questions.answer: The face painting typically lasts 4-6 hours, depending on activity level. To remove, simply use soap and warm water. Avoid harsh rubbing - gentle washing removes the paint easily.

questions.question: What are your prices?
questions.answer: My prices vary depending on duration, number of children, and type of event. Please contact me for a personalized quote. I offer competitive prices for various occasions.

contact.title: Have more questions?
contact.description: Don't hesitate to reach out! I'm happy to discuss your specific needs and help make your event magical.
